2609.12544.title: Meddies-PII: A Multilingual Framework for Personally Identifiable Information Extraction in Clinical De-identification
2609.12544.paper_summary: Clinical de-identification relies on accurately identifying personally identifiable information (PII). However, manually annotated datasets are costly to construct, while existing synthetic alternatives often provide limited details about their generation process or rely on relatively simple synthesis strategies. We introduce Meddies-PII-Dataset, a corpus of one million synthetic clinical documents spanning seventeen languages and nine PII labels. The documents are generated using attribute-conditioned prompts and validated through thirteen deterministic gates that enforce structural and annotation consistency. To evaluate the dataset's utility, we train Meddies-PII-Model, a BIOES token classifier, and compare it with existing PII extraction systems using exact-match entity-level F1. Meddies-PII-Model achieves the highest performance among the evaluated systems on all reported benchmarks, with a mean F1 of 0.827 across fifteen external benchmarks, compared with 0.658 for the strongest baseline. Upon acceptance, we will publicly release the dataset, benchmark suite, model, generation framework, and evaluation code to support research on multilingual clinical de-identification.
2609.12544.paper_summary_zh: 臨床去識別依賴於準確識別個人識別信息（PII）。然而，手動標註的數據集建構成本高昂，而現有的合成替代品往往對其生成過程提供有限的細節或依賴於相對簡單的合成策略。我們介紹了Meddies-PII-Dataset，這是一個包含一百萬份合成臨床文檔的語料庫，涵蓋十七種語言和九個PII標籤。這些文檔是使用屬性條件提示生成的，並通過十三個確定性閘進行驗證，以強制執行結構和標註的一致性。為了評估數據集的實用性，我們訓練了Meddies-PII-Model，一個BIOES標記分類器，並使用精確匹配實體級F1將其與現有的PII提取系統進行比較。Meddies-PII-Model在所有報告的基準中，在評估的系統中達到了最高的性能，在十五個外部基準中的平均F1為0.827，而最強基線的F1為0.658。經過接受後，我們將公開釋放數據集、基準套件、模型、生成框架和評估代碼，以支持多語言臨床去識別的研究。
